product_metadata.title: Eternal Beauty Gold Square Sequin Tablecloth Sequin Overlay Tablecloth for Wedding Christmas Party 48"x48"
features: Unique Sequin Fabric: 3MM round high density material sequins with mesh fabric backing.Keep shiny brightness and durability of the tablecloth. You can put a white cloth under the tablecloth, it will have a more shiny effect.
High Workmanship:The tablecloth have serge edges,it could avoid falling sequins. Beautiful sequined tablecloths make your wedding party even more elegant and high-grade.

Pls Noted: The surface of tablecloth is SMOOTH which is not prickly. With seams when the width is over 4ft. But it isn't in the middle and the seam position is well-designed and symmetrical so barely shown.
Perfect for wedding party, Christmas, Thanksgiving Day, Halloween, birthday, party, reception, baby shower, buffet, prom and more

Other Attention: When you remove the tablecloth from the package if some sequins fall off.Just shake off these sequins before you use it. And you can refer to our size chart to choose the right size, or you can email us for help.
